payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute prefix sums, then for each month check violation: 100*p[i] - k*prefix[i-1]. Max violation ceil divided by k gives minimal total increase, optimally added to earliest prices.
payload.rationale: The algorithm uses a greedy observation that increasing earlier prices minimizes total change, as it affects all subsequent months. No sorting or data structures are needed; optimality follows from an exchange argument.
